title: Apply for a second-hand dealer licence
summary: Find out what you need to do if you want to run a business buying and selling used items or unwanted goods, or if you offer loans using property as collateral.
intro:
If you want to run a business buying and selling used items or unwanted, unused goods such as gifts, you'll need a second-hand dealer licence.

If you offer loans to people using their property as collateral, you'll also need a pawnbroker licence.

Pawnbroker and second-hand dealer licences can be issued separately, or together as a combined licence.
who_can_apply: Be a fit and proper person to hold a licence.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for a Licence Under the Pawnbrokers and Second-Hand Dealers Act'
Proof of identity (such as driver licence or passport).

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre, or by email using the details on the form.

faqs.q: What kind of licence do I need if I buy and sell used items?
faqs.a: You will need a second-hand dealer licence. If you also offer loans using property as collateral, you will need a pawnbroker licence.

faqs.q: Can I get a combined licence?
faqs.a: Pawnbroker and second-hand dealer licences can be issued separately, or together as a combined licence.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a licence?
faqs.a: Select the 'Download PDF form' button, complete the form, and submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre, or by email using the details on the form.
